 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. A lot of Las Vegas Raiders fans were upset to see quarterback Kirk Cousins get traded to the Minnesota Vikings earlier this week.
 Star tight end Brock Bowers was upset for a completely different reason.
 Brock Bowers #89 of the Las Vegas Raiders walks off the field after losing to the New England Patriots at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Mass., Oct. 11, 2026. Getty Images
 His fiancée, Cameron Newell , revealed this with an Instagram story post on Saturday night .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She posted a photo of herself crying with and holding her and Brock's dog's head in her hands and wrote, "Really exposing myself here but consider this your warning if you decide to watch The Art of Racing in the Rain (it's about a dog)
 "Brock was balling too," the post continued.
 Brock Bowers's fiancée Cameron Newell's Instagram story post holding her dog. (Instagram/@cameronrnewell).
 The Art of Racing in the Rain is a movie that was released in 2019 and is told from a golden retriever's point of view.
 Without giving away spoilers, the movie contains some heartbreaking and emotional twists that clearly got to Bowers and Newell.
 Brock Bowers' fiancée Cameron Newell poses for a photo in a red dress. (Instagram/@cameronrnewell).
 Not to mention that they have a golden retriever themselves, which surely added another emotional layer.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bowers and the rest of the Raiders are facing the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks on Sunday.
 Hopefully Bowers was able to refocus his attention before the game, or else he might be playing with more emotion than usual.
